evidence.hierarchy: Thumbnail: the mirror is the dominant object and the headline is readable, but secondary facts are fragmented around it. At width720 the orange CTA is findable upper-right while date, admission, address and age are pushed to the lower-right.
evidence.typography: Usage/native: the upper-left headline, small left column, orange condensed CTA, right middle paragraphs and lower-right schedule use several independent measures. Each is legible, but the action URL is visibly compressed compared with the broad headline, and the copy does not read as one editorial sequence.
evidence.space: Native: the mirror silhouette and crossing screwdriver make an effective central image. The title fills the upper-left while facts occupy several leftover areas; the empty right-center gap above the tool and separated lower schedule reduce continuity.
evidence.image_material: Native: the wooden frame grain follows its faces, the glass has a soft reflected scene, the metal pivot has coherent highlights, and the base receives a plausible shadow. The screwdriver contacts the pivot clearly. This is workmanship assessment, not proof of actual operation.
evidence.emotion_control: Native: warm wood and pale blue produce a calm, cared-for household mood. The orange action line is a purposeful alert rather than an added decoration.
evidence.ai_slop: Native: object, reflection, tool contact and shadows form a coherent specific repair image, with no conspicuous synthetic seam or corrupted copy. The studio backdrop is familiar but the depicted repair action gives it a reason to be here.

residuals: Date, time, place and eligibility are separated from the upper action block and found last in the lower-right corner.
Narrow orange URL lettering and multiple measures make the information arrangement less coherent.
Large mirror and tool are well made, but the text distribution leaves a disconnected right-center region.

evidence.content_form: Native: a hand presses a folded cup while the translucent lid sits separately at lower-left. The localized fold gesture makes the slogan's action visible and gives the photograph a stronger content/form relationship than a neutral two-state display.
evidence.hierarchy: Thumbnail: the large Fold Cup title and hand/cup relationship lead together. At width720 the top-left release/pre-order/URL block is fully readable and easy to find, followed by slogan and material line beside the product.
evidence.typography: Native/usage: the stacked title and two-line Korean slogan occupy the left column beside the hand/cup action; the release block is compact above. Bold title/release and lighter details create a consistent system. Clearance near the title's lower-right and fingertip is tight but not a confirmed collision.
evidence.space: Native: the hand enters from upper-right, the cup anchors lower-right and the detached lid crops off the lower-left. This creates an intentional diagonal and explains why text occupies the left-upper space; the edge crops and uneven masses have clear roles.
evidence.image_material: Native: skin pores, nail highlights, dark-green silicone grain and the cloudy white lid share diffuse studio light. Fold bands bend locally under the hand with coherent shading; the lid edge is low contrast but visible. This does not certify physical collapse behavior or 350mL capacity.
evidence.emotion_control: Native: close tactile handling gives a practical, soft, usable-product feeling. The neutral field and minimal props let the single gesture carry the expression.
evidence.ai_slop: Native: hand pressure, compressed bands and separate lid are edited around the actual folding proposition. No definite extra-finger, lettering, edge or shadow corruption is visible. The close studio style is familiar, but the image and surrounding typography perform a specific task.

residuals: Tight clearance between the title's lower-right area and the nearest fingertip warrants retaining a small spacing doubt.
The translucent lid has low contrast against the light floor, though it is readable at native and width720.
A still image cannot establish capacity or actual folding operation; only photo-like visible workmanship is judged.

coast-cleanup-dense-action.evidence: The photographic vertical X871 uses shoreline as context and a left text spine beside a real-looking cleanup action. Landscape X280 turns a graphic bag into the information container under a yellow headline. This changes conception, image vocabulary, type/image roles and spatial structure. With only two current members, they are necessarily the set's closest pair; their shared bold title/action emphasis does not reduce the difference to color treatment.
residuals: Both retain oversized heavy sans headlines and visibly pragmatic information blocks, so the range is strong but not maximal.
X280's graphic material treatment and X871's conventional softened photo text field remain the local weaker aspects.

foln-product-mixed-copy.evidence: X442 shows two static states on warm orange, with title and launch copy in the upper/right column. X251 uses a neutral close photograph of a pressing hand, a separately cropped lid, left-side title and a release block above. The demonstrated gesture and crop are a substantive change beyond palette. However both place a large stacked Fold/Cup next to green product photography over a plain studio field, with the same dark-green sans vocabulary. The current pair, not the comparison image, determines this score.
residuals: This is the narrowest current-set diversity: the same stacked title, flat studio setting and hero-product strategy persist.
X442's broad upper-left field and X251's close fingertip/type clearance show different local weaknesses; neither member compensates for the other.

heldout-repair-cafe-dense.evidence: X759 uses detailed assisting hands and an open box to make repair collaborative, distributing upper facts to the right and lower conditions below the scene. X856 is a black/white/red type-led square with one thin mirror-pivot icon and a continuous left information spine. Image scale, rendering vocabulary, emotional emphasis and copy topology differ credibly. Only two members means the closest pair is those two. Shared very bold sans recruitment language keeps the set from maximal range.
residuals: X759 retains a generic friendly-explainer package and lower-list typography.
X856 is more coherent for action scanning but socially less warm and still text-heavy.

pair1.reason: X280's bag-shaped information field connects provision of collection bags, cleanup action and the text surface, while its bottom application band and left/right bag columns read as one composition. X101 is readable and warmer socially, but coral subheading, opposite alignments and text islands around volunteers leave a more generic and busy whole.
pair1.uncertainty: Moderate. A's human scene may suit a deliberately friendly recruitment tone better; no such tone priority is specified. All required copy passes in both, and the decision is not a claim that bold yellow is intrinsically superior.

pair2.reason: X442 makes Fold Cup the first product message and organizes descriptor, launch and pre-order into stronger visible tiers, supported by coherent orange/green/white material relationships. X701 has clear paired-state photography and more prominent FOLN, but its message sits low under a broad gray cap and its lower text has a catalogue rhythm.
pair2.uncertainty: Moderate. Both use a conventional two-state studio display and neither proves physical performance. If brand-name prominence or quiet neutrality were the primary preference, A could be favored; the brief does not establish those priorities.

pair3.reason: X856 places a clear full-width red deadline/URL immediately below the recruitment headline and gathers date/time/place/eligibility into one reading spine. X239's excellent mirror/wood/tool photograph gives a warmer material story, but the fragmented surrounding text leaves the schedule low and the action URL narrowly condensed.
pair3.uncertainty: Low to moderate. B is more immediately useful for the stated easy-to-find participation action. A's photographic appeal is a real strength, and both remain mandatory passes; the preference does not depend on minimalism being inherently better.

portfolio_assessment.evidence: Among the six current deliverables, X442/X251 share the most editorial vocabulary: large two-line Fold/Cup, dark-green sans type, green hero product and simple studio surface. Coast and repair pairs change image/text roles more deeply. Across briefs, heavy sans recruitment headlines and fairly bold informational copy recur, but photo-action, bag-as-panel, tactile product demonstration, assisting-hands scene and sparse repair icon provide genuine differences. The current set's weakest dimensions remain visible in X759 typography/AI-slop and X442 space; their stronger companions do not erase them.
portfolio_assessment.limits: No portfolio average is given. Scores refer to delivered relationships and workmanship, not inferred production method.
